title: telemetry
description: Platform-owned keys of the telemetry addon. Upstream subchart keys are not constrained; cross-field checks live in templates/validate.yaml.

keep.description: Regex of the metric families kept before remote write (agent memory).

cluster.description: Injected by the addon ApplicationSet with --set-string, so every value is a string.

name.description: Cluster name; becomes CLUSTER_NAME (k8s.cluster.name) on every signal.

host.description: Base domain; the observability plane is opensearch/prometheus.observability.<host>.

enabled.description: Observability plane installed; false contradicts this addon (validate.yaml).

httpPort.description: Gateway HTTP port of prometheus.observability.<host> (remote write).

tlsPort.description: Gateway TLS port of opensearch.observability.<host> (logs, traces, events).

store.description: ClusterSecretStore the OpenSearch credentials come from (workload clusters: default).

remoteKey.description: Store key holding the Datadog API key.

property.description: Property of remoteKey with the API key.

gatewayMetrics.description: PodMonitor for the Envoy gateway upstream request metrics.

hubbleMetrics.description: ServiceMonitor for Cilium Hubble HTTP metrics (OpenChoreo observer metric: http).

observability-logs-opensearch.description: Upstream OpenChoreo Fluent Bit subchart (not constrained; endpoint checked in validate.yaml).

observability-metrics-prometheus.description: Upstream OpenChoreo Prometheus agent subchart (not constrained; URL checked in validate.yaml).

observability-events-otel-collector.description: Upstream OpenChoreo k8s-events collector subchart (not constrained).
